description:
Activate Jadzi by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Resolve all Jadzi abilities, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

uses.name: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle
